subject: Sponsor synthesis & action path — Vertex Health pilot next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vertexhealth.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor synthesis & action path — Vertex Health pilot next steps

Thanks for the time today — summary below to make sure we have the same prioritization and next steps for the pilot. Please reply with any corrections or missing owners.

Key business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce per-call inference spend by ~35–45% vs current cloud exec endpoints (target: cost/1000 tokens).
- Maintain 90th percentile latency under 220ms for critical workflows (patient-facing search + triage).
- Ship pilot that validates accuracy and auditability for PHI flows (secure VPC option).

Top pain points called out:
1) Latency spikes under concurrent load during morning sync (current 99th ~800ms).
2) Lack of detailed audit logs for token-level access and redaction policy.
3) Procurement needs clear path: SOC2 + encryption proof, PO timeline, and standard MSA language.

Risks we flagged:
- Data residency: any hosting must meet their EU/US data split for subsets of patient records.
- Fallback model: if performance degrades under burst, need automatic degraded-mode (smaller model) that keeps availability.
- Legal review: templated MSA may need a short cycle to accept our indemnity and SLA clauses.

Redwood commitments (deliverables):
- Pilot scope doc (attached: vertex-pilot-scope.pdf) with technical checklist and success metrics (owner: Connor) — draft by 2026-05-07.
- SOC2 excerpt and encryption summary (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) — Hannah to provide by 2026-05-06.
- Exec one-page ROI summary for Marcus/CFO (exec-ROI-onepager.pdf) — Laura to draft by 2026-05-10.
- Technical onboarding: sandbox cluster + sample data plan, and a 60–90 minute technical demo for engineers/ops (tentative week of 5/17).

Procurement path we discussed:
- Security review (SOC2 docs + pen-test summary) -> Procurement intake + legal -> PO/contract (expected 2–3 week cycle once intake is accepted).
- Vertex indicated procurement will prefer a single annual PO for the pilot scope then convert to reserved capacity if successful.

Immediate asks of Vertex (owners):
- Exec sponsor confirmation (who will be the single approver for PO) — Alicia?
- Procurement contact and expected PO date range (Tom? Sara Lin?).
- Any show-stopper constraints on data residency/encryption.

Next steps (dates):
- 2026-05-06: Redwood sends SOC2 excerpt + pilot scope (Connor/Hannah).
- 2026-05-10: Exec ROI one-pager for Marcus (Laura).
- Week of 2026-05-17: Technical demo + integration plan meeting.

Attachments: vertex-pilot-scope.pdf (draft), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Connor / Alicia — thanks for the quick follow-up. We're aligned to move forward with the pilot. A few operational notes from procurement/ops: 

- Procurement contact: Sara Lin (cc'd). Our target is to have a PO in place by 2026-06-01. Procurement will ask for line-item pricing and a short statement of work.
